acceptance_criteria.description: SBOMDetails renders loading, empty, attestation, NTIA compliance, vulnerability, package-table, and sparse-data states without throwing.
PolicyRuleBuilder renders existing rules and disabled controls correctly.
PolicyRuleBuilder supports modal category/rule selection and creates rules with no params, multiselect params, numeric params, select params, and text-list params.
PolicyRuleBuilder supports removing configured rules and closing the add modal without creating a rule.
Vitest is configured to discover both existing JavaScript unit specs and the new TypeScript unit specs.
